summary: Transform your approach to leadership in the nonprofit sector. Enroll in our course on Ethical Leadership and empower yourself to inspire others effectively.
lede: Ethical leadership in nonprofits helps governance and program professionals assess ethics risks and build accountable practices. Designed for people in governance, programs, fundraising, safeguarding, compliance, finance, and board oversight, it covers applying the PLUS decision-making model, developing conduct and conflict-of-interest policies, and setting up whistleblowing workflows. Participants also practice ethics audits, stakeholder accountability, and board-level reporting, with an introduction to digital monitoring and external reporting concepts.
audienceIntro: This course is built for you if you work in nonprofit governance, program delivery, fundraising, safeguarding, compliance, finance, or board oversight and need practical ethical leadership tools. It fits foundation to intermediate professionals who already operate in mission-driven organizations and want stronger methods for handling real ethics issues.
prerequisites: Before attending, you should bring familiarity with your organization’s mission, governance structure, and current ethics-related policies if available. A recent complaint case, conflict of interest issue, whistleblowing concern, donor pressure example, or safeguarding challenge will help you complete the applied exercises more effectively.
